text:
Silver Price in 1978
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1978, the LBMA silver price rose 21.6% between 1978-01-31 ($4.95) and 1978-12-29 ($6.02). The highest sampled price was $6.26 in October and the lowest was $4.95 in January. The mean of these observations was $5.50. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
